SELECT ad.*, u.nickname as applicant_nickname, u.phone as applicant_phone, a.name as animal_name, a.breed as animal_breed, a.photos as animal_photos FROM adoption_apply ad LEFT JOIN user u ON ad.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN animal a ON ad.animal_id = a.id WHERE ad.deleted = 0
AND ad.stage = #{params.stage}
AND ad.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.realName}, '%')
ORDER BY ad.create_time DESC
